yakvc.menu.title: Voice Chat
yakvc.groups.title: Voice Groups
yakvc.groups.status.none: Not in a group. Group members hear each other at any distance.
yakvc.groups.name: Group name
yakvc.groups.password.tooltip: Keeps strangers out of the group. Don't reuse a real password: anyone on the server can try to guess it.
yakvc.groups.nearby.tooltip: Off: only your group hears you, and you hear only your group.
yakvc.groups.error.name: Group names are 1 to 32 characters
yakvc.settings.title: Voice Settings
yakvc.settings.bitrate.tooltip: Higher sounds better and uses more data. 24 kbit/s is plenty for speech.
yakvc.settings.ip_note: Other Yak VC players on the server learn your IP address, unless Relay Only is on.
yakvc.settings.relay_only.tooltip: All voice goes through the relay, so other players don't learn your IP address. Applies after restarting the game.
yakvc.settings.respect_chat_restrictions: Turn voice off while your Microsoft account or launcher disables chat.
yakvc.settings.mute_blocked_players.tool: Players you blocked in Social Interactions can't hear you and you don't hear them.
yakvc.settings.account.verified: Your Minecraft account is verified: other players see a badge next to your name.
yakvc.settings.account.unverified: You're playing without a verified Minecraft account: voice works on offline-mode servers only, and players who allow only verified players don't hear you.
yakvc.settings.account.not_connected: Not connected to Yak VC yet.
yakvc.settings.verified_only.tooltip: Only talk with players whose Minecraft account is verified (they have a badge next to their name). Players without an account, as on offline-mode servers, can't hear you and you don't hear them.
yakvc.settings.debug_overlay.tooltip: Shows connection and audio details in the top right, for testing and bug reports. Also has a key in Controls; not saved.
yakvc.toast.title: Yak VC voice chat
yakvc.toast.unsupported: Voice chat doesn't support this system yet.
yakvc.toast.load_failed: Voice chat couldn't load its engine. See the game log.
yakvc.settings.unavailable: Voice chat is off for this game, so its settings can't be changed. The game log says why.
yakvc.toast.crashed: Voice chat crashed and is off until you restart the game.
yakvc.toast.settings_not_saved: Settings applied but not saved. See the game log.
